purpose: Manage browser-local recent-page history and optional-reporting consent alongside deployment consent policy.
primaryGoal: Understand local data scope, clear recent history safely, and accept, withdraw or reset the browser's consent choice.

dataSources.name: Deployment consent policy
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['version']; STANDARD stale time; abort signal forwarded; optional require_cookie_consent boolean is treated as unknown unless actually boolean. No backend handler implementation or live response verified.

dataSources.name: Recent pages
dataSources.behavior: Browser-local LRU capped at 50; page initializes count from getRecentPages().length and subscribes to same-tab and storage events. Clear removes the key and notifies subscribers; no server mutation.

dataSources.name: Consent
dataSources.behavior: accepted/declined stored literally; unknown means missing/invalid/unavailable storage. Same-tab cookie-consent-changed plus cross-tab storage subscriptions. Reporting allowance depends on both deployment policy and persisted consent.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Existing category-barrel adapter; full allocated width, min-w-0, shell-owned scope; query supplies freshness metadata, not a page-content gate.

components.name: PrivacyOperationalBrief / OperationalBrief
components.contract: Four metrics through useOperationalMetrics; count, consent, deployment policy, browser scope; unknown common period explicitly explained.

components.name: RecentPagesPanel
components.contract: GlassPanel, PanelTitle, Text, IconBox and Button; polite count status, zero-count hint, disabled clear when empty.

components.name: ConsentControlPanel
components.contract: GlassPanel, StatusPill, Skeleton, Button and typography; independent policy load/error while browser-local actions stay usable.

components.name: PrivacyGuaranteesPanel
components.contract: Three localized tiles: stored locally, no cross-device sync, immediate control; heading association retained.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.contract: warning variant, localized title/body/actions, clear-recent-pages silence key, cancellation and confirmation; existing Modal remains overlay owner.

components.name: FadeIn
components.contract: Existing motion preference; reduced mode initial=false and safe delay; no replacement motion library.

components.name: deriveDataState
components.contract: Retains payload on refresh error/paused fetch; fatal and refresh errors distinct.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Alternate four-card privacy summary remains exported by privacy/index.ts:1; mounted PrivacyPage uses PrivacyOperationalBrief instead. This is a competing source renderer, not proof of a second mounted summary.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep mounted OperationalBrief canonical; inspect remaining callers and tests before any separate cleanup. Do not remove capabilities or resurrect the alternate band during modernization.

sourceEvidence: PrivacyPage.tsx:142-145 controls stack below xl and become two columns at xl.
PrivacyGuaranteesPanel.tsx:91 tiles reflow one/two/three columns at base/sm/xl.
RecentPagesPanel.tsx:35,46 and ConsentControlPanel.tsx:50,99,110 use min-w-0 and wrapping; all three consent actions remain rendered.

issues.detail: Action buttons use default md sizing (40px in Button.tsx:39); retry uses sm (36px). wrapLabel is not enabled. Source does not establish the stronger 44px mobile target or long-translation fit.
issues.fix: Use existing Button sizing/class composition and wrapLabel where necessary; verify 320px, long localized labels and non-overlapping target spacing without hiding actions.

sourceEvidence: ConsentControlPanel.tsx:98-104 has textual status with a colored pill, not color-only meaning.
PrivacyPage.tsx:143 labels controls; PrivacyGuaranteesPanel.tsx:87-89 associates explanatory heading.
Feature SVG icons are aria-hidden; shared Button supplies visible focus classes; FadeIn reuses reduced-motion handling.
accessibility.acceptance: Keyboard traversal, modal focus/restoration, screen-reader announcements, composed contrast, forced colors and actual touch-target reachability are unverified.

states.initial: Only policy text skeleton/loading reason; browser count, consent actions and guarantees remain mounted.
states.empty: Zero recent pages shows helpful hint and disables clear. Unknown consent remains an explicit state; missing policy is null, never Optional by default in summary.
states.fatalError: Policy-only retry in summary and consent panel; PageLayout receives query only, not loading/error replacement props.
states.retained: Refresh failure preserves policy and browser-local neighbors; stale notice and retained-policy summary label remain.
states.offline: deriveDataState marks retained paused fetch stale; initial paused fetch remains initial. Offline-versus-loading recovery is not separately exposed by this page.

issues.detail: Stale notice receives only state='stale'; summary receives fatalError, not refreshError, and no paused-fetch reason. Existing retry buttons appear only for fatal/missing policy. Retained-policy refresh failure lacks source-specific retry/context here.
issues.fix: Keep retained policy and independent local actions; expose existing refreshError/isRefreshBlocked with a nonfatal policy-scoped recovery action. Distinguish paused initial fetch from ordinary loading using existing trust primitives.

issues.detail: Declined copy claims 'only essential storage in use', but cookieConsent.ts:164 permits reporting whenever requireCookieConsent is false, regardless of the local declined choice. The consent description has no deployment-policy input.
issues.fix: Preserve existing reporting policy and browser choice; qualify status copy by known deployment policy and label policy-unknown honestly instead of promising effective reporting withdrawal when the consent gate is disabled.

issues.detail: Handlers display unconditional success and explicitly update consent state after helper writes. cookieConsent.ts:88-99 silently drops unavailable/failed writes yet dispatches requested state. recentPages.ts:238-242 similarly ignores clear failure; toast still says cleared. Storage failure can make UI success differ from persisted state.
issues.fix: Coordinate storage-owner result/evidence reporting, then surface unavailable/persistence failure without breaking local subscriptions, storage keys or consent gating. Preserve usable controls and avoid treating failed persistence as confirmed consent.

visualIssues.detail: Three informational guarantee icons use cyan/blue/green; controls add cyan/amber. IconBox.tsx:26-32 maps these to neon-tinted backgrounds/rings in tokens.ts:21-26. These hues distinguish decorative topics rather than operational severity. No glow is applied by IconBox itself.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer neutral token-based icon chrome for explanatory topics through the shared owner; reserve subdued semantic emphasis for actual consent/policy state and the clear confirmation. Preserve all explanatory tiles and user-selected themes.

architectureIssues.detail: useToast imports the concrete shared Toast module while other page shared imports use category barrels.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing feedback category export if confirmed available; do not invent a new provider or wrapper. Barrel export availability was not inspected.

priority.first: Correct policy-dependent consent claims and persistence-success evidence.
priority.next: Expose nonfatal refresh/offline recovery; reduce decorative multihue chrome using the existing design system; verify mobile targets.
priority.notNeeded: No SI conversion, date-range picker, vehicle selector, chart/table replacement or new query state store.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Neutral IconBox presentation
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing children/size/className/color API has only NeonColor variants. Evaluate an optional neutral semantic tone backed by current surface/text/border tokens, retaining existing color defaults and sizes.
requiredSharedChanges.implementationStatus: proposal only; independent second production page need not established by this scoped audit

requiredSharedChanges.name: Browser-storage mutation evidence
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Coordinate a compatible mutation result distinguishing persisted, unavailable and failed writes, plus authoritative readback; retain consent event names, accepted/declined/unknown meanings, recent LRU cap and storage IDs.
dependsOn: Existing privacy storage and reporting policy
requiredSharedChanges.implementationStatus: report only; no shared source changed

competingImplementations.name: PrivacyKpiCards versus PrivacyOperationalBrief
competingImplementations.detail: Alternate summary exported, current page mounts only OperationalBrief. Unused across repository not established; no deletion recommended by audit.

actions: Persist Don't ask again choice under clear-recent-pages
dataBehavior: Single browser-local subscriptions per store with cleanup
Deployment boolean remains unknown if absent
Local actions remain independent of policy query
preservation.workspace: Account route is not RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS and is covered by VEHICLE_DISABLED_PREFIXES '/account' (workspaceScope.ts:23-78,95-97). Do not introduce competing scope controls.
preservation.si: No physical SI measurements on this page; count/status/text only. Preserve raw values and existing operational formatting preferences.

evidenceLimits.method: Bounded source-only read and line-pattern/hash inspection; no Git, production mutations, tests, build, lint or browser sessions.
evidenceLimits.tests: not run; existing test files enumerated only, not read
evidenceLimits.skillScript: Read audit.sh but did not execute: it unconditionally runs project TypeScript outside the bounded source audit.

sourceOnlyChecks.command: Select-String over the five hashed presentation files; case-sensitive raw HTML regex
sourceOnlyChecks.limitation: Regex counts are not runtime acceptance. Initial case-insensitive raw-element probe counted five shared Button tags; corrected case-sensitive probe found zero native tags.

evidenceLimits.backend: Router and frontend version type inspected; backend handler semantics, consent enforcement and live reporter delivery not exercised.
evidenceLimits.otherConsumers: No application-wide dependency/caller audit; exported alternate renderer not proved globally unused.
